en:
I don't think Himiko used the crossbow.
More accurately...she <CLT=cltSTRONG>couldn't use it<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
Couldn't use it? Why not?
The crossbow inside this case was <CLT=cltSTRONG>disassembled<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Kaito and I learned how to assemble the
crossbow from Maki, so we could have done it.

But I don't believe someone without the
proper training could have assembled it.

Well...what if Maki taught Himiko how 
to assemble the crossbow?

Sh-She didn't teach me that!
Right, Maki!?

Wh-What's wrong?
Are you...mad about before?

S-Sorry...I thought they were gonna
suspect me, so...I lied.

I really have to question your morals if
you're blaming Maki for your lie, Himiko!

I don't think you're allowed to
say something like that...

I'm sorry, Maki...
Please...can you tell them the truth?
Fine... I'm not going to lie.

I didn't teach Himiko how to assemble the
crossbow. She couldn't have used it.

See! I told you!
It's just like I said!

Everyone who suspected me
needs to apologize right now!

She changed back so fast...
I think I might have whiplash now...

Then...why did you bring the crossbow
to the hangar, Himiko?
I...was asked to.
<CLT=cltMIND>Asked to...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Perhaps the person
who asked was...
Kokichi Oma
It was Kokichi, right?

What!? Like I'd ever do 
something Kokichi asked me!

Kokichi doesn't even know how
to assemble the crossbow, right?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Kaito Momota
Maki Harukawa
It was Maki, right?
Huh? Why would I ask for such a thing?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Keebo
It was Keebo, right?

Huh...? I only saw her carrying it...
I never asked her to carry it.

Keebo wouldn't be able to build it,
so I think that's not right...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

I was just asked to...
I'm telling the truth...

Please, Shuichi...
Can you explain it to everyone?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me...
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud...
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>The person who asked Himiko
to bring the crossbow...
Was it...<CLT=cltSTRONG>Kaito<CLT=cltNORMAL>?
Huh? Kaito?

Only Kaito or Kokichi would have asked
for a crossbow to be brought to the hangar.

Because Kaito knows how to assemble the
crossbow, he certainly could have used it.

Knowing that...I can't imagine that
anyone else would have asked Himiko.

I do not think she would bring it at Kokichi's
request...

Of course not!
Why would I ever listen to Kokichi?
Cuz I know you like meeee.
Nuh-uh! I hate you!
But I like you.
Nyeh!?
Hey! Don't play with Himiko's heart!

<CLT=cltMIND>But to think that Kaito
asked Himiko to do that...

<CLT=cltMIND>Maybe Kaito is trying to keep the
promise we made yesterday...

Don't you worry!
I'll do something about all this!
That's a promise!

All you guys are working so hard,
so I can't just sit back and relax!

But why were you keeping that
a secret, Himiko?

Well, Kaito...sorta asked me to keep
it a secret...

Then Kaito died and...I got scared.
I thought I was gonna be next.

You're the worst for trying to pin the
blame on Maki just for that reason!

Maki, teach this dumb monkey the 
true terror of human beings!
Don't bully the person you like!

This is way beyond bullying a 
grade school crush...

Himiko, when exactly did Kaito ask you
to do this?

Ummm... I think it was around
evening yesterday.

I was so nervous about fighting
Kokichi, I couldn't get to sleep...

So I took a walk near the hangar, and
that's when Kaito called out to me.

I got startled, and wet myself a little, 
and then he asked me to get him a crossbow.

Umm...that one part was, uh...
You know what? Never mind.

So if Kaito asked for a crossbow, does 
that mean he was going to kill Kokichi?

No, he said it was to disable Kokichi.
I wouldn't have helped him otherwise.

I trusted Kaito and took a crossbow
from Maki's lab.
That's when I witnessed Himiko.

But then what did Kaito do
after he had the crossbow?

I dunno. I just handed him the crossbow
then went right back to the dorms.

Presumably, Kaito tried to attack Kokichi,
only to be disarmed of the crossbow...

and then, Kokichi returned fire and shot Kaito.
That sequence of events seems logical.

No, it happened a little differently.
Both Kaito and Kokichi shot the crossbow.
<CLT=cltMIND>And there's proof of that...
Maybe the bloodstain was Kokichi's...

We can't tell whose blood is whose.
None of us can do forensics stuff.

Maybe if we could've seen some
wounds, we could make a guess...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

After Kaito shot the crossbow, Kokichi
took it from him and shot back...
That's purely speculation.

We could confirm it if Kokichi showed himself.
But since he won't come out of the Exisal...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

There were three arrows in the bathroom,
perhaps Kaito shot one of them...

However, it is also possible that Kokichi
shot all three arrows.

Without a body to check for injuries, the
number of arrows doesn't really help us...

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

Well? Weren't you going
to say something?

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

I don't think that's a proper justification for
claiming that Kaito shot the crossbow...

Kaito's clothes had an arrow hole, so it's more
plausible to think that Kokichi shot him.

<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone's staring at me... 
I screwed up, they think I'm a fraud... 
<CLT=cltNORMAL>

What evidence shows that Kaito shot
Kokichi with the crossbow?

Remember that when we found Kokichi's clothes,
there were <CLT=cltSTRONG>holes<CLT=cltNORMAL> in the back and sleeve.

The same kind of hole that was found
on Kaito's coat.
So Kokichi was shot by the crossbow, too?
Then it was Kaito who shot him, right?

Hmmm, I'm not suuure.
I don't remember anything like thaaat.

You don't remember whether
or not you were shot...?

There is no doubt that they shot each other
with the crossbow, but—
It doesn't matter.
...Huh?

It doesn't matter what happened in between.
In the end, Kokichi killed Kaito.

<CLT=cltMIND>Maki's been acting
strangely...

<CLT=cltMIND>But why?
Does she know something?
<CLT=cltMIND>If so...what does she know?

Maybe Maki's right. It doesn't matter
what happened in the middle.

Cuz in the end, there's no mistake
that Kokichi killed Kaito.
Then, let's hurry up and vote—
No, it's too soon. There are still mysteries—

Who cares about that? We already know
who the culprit is.
You sure about that?
...Huh?
What? Now he's joining in?

As the one running this trial, it bothers me
when anyone says mysteries don't matter.

It affects the overall entertainment value, so I
encourage you to reaaaally think about things.

After all, there should be some mysteries
that still matter...

For example, <CLT=cltSTRONG>is Kokichi really inside that
Exisal<CLT=cltNORMAL>? Stuff like that...
...What?

What are you saying? We already 
finished that discussion awhile ago.

Kokichi's gotta still be alive, since
the killing game's still going.

His voice is even coming from 
the Exisal and everything.

But we heard it speak in Kaito's voice
earlier, didn't we?

Yeah, don't rely on that. After all,
this Exisal has a voice changer.
<CLT=cltMIND>...It what?

Hah! Cuz of that, nobody realizes
I'm pretending to be Kokichi!

But no more!
Sorry for the wait, guys!

The Luminary of the Stars has arrived! 
This time for real!
Wh-What? What's going on?

I told you, I'm Kaito. I was just 
pretending to be Kokichi is all.

There's a bit of a situation going
on, so I didn't really have a choice...

Sorry about tricking you guys
like that. My bad!
Huh? So Kaito's in there after all!?

...Don't be stupid. How many times
are you going to be tricked by him?
That's Kokichi pretending to be Kaito.

Hey now, Maki Roll.
Don't you believe me?
Don't...*ever*...call me that!

Whoa there! Chill!
You really think I'm Kokichi?

I mean, I guess I understand. Sorry I can't
really get outta this thing right now.
Why not?

I can't move cuz of the injury I got
from Kokichi...

It's so bad, I can't even stand.
That's why I'm in this Exisal.
I-Is that so...?

But if you guys don't believe me,
then we can't move on...
So, you're up, Shuichi!
What!? Me!?

Explain to everyone how I wasn't
the one that died!
<CLT=cltMIND>Kaito is alive after all...

<CLT=cltMIND>No...maybe...that's just what I
want to believe. Is it really true?
<CLT=cltMIND>What story does the evidence tell?

<CLT=cltMIND>Does that story end with Kaito
or Kokichi being the victim?

<CLT=cltMIND>I need to give a well-reasoned
answer to that question, and soon.
<CLT=cltMIND>...I can't look away from the truth.
Kokichi Oma

<CLT=cltMIND>Most of the evidence we have now...
shows that Kaito is the victim!

Hm? What's the matter, Shuichi?
You just gotta say it with confidence!

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't look away from the truth!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
Kaito Momota

Hm? What's the matter, Shuichi?
You just gotta say it with confidence!

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't look away from the truth!
<CLT=cltNORMAL>
<CLT=cltMIND>The victim of this case is...

<CLT=cltMIND>I'm trying, I really am, but I can't
think of anyone other than Kaito...

<CLT=cltMIND>Most of the evidence we have
points to Kaito...
Hey, what's the matter, Shuichi?

Just hurry up and tell everyone
why I'm not dead! Should be easy!
No...I won't. Because you're not Kaito.
Kaito is already dead!

Puhuhuhu! Good, good! This is already
more entertaining!

Now, the Ultimate Academy is proud to present
its very own <CLT=cltSTRONG>morphenomenal trial grounds<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
Alright! Let's give it everything we've got!
